note: An INBAL-hosted scholarly publication gives the exact bibliographic pointer El Instructor, Aguascalientes, 1 January 1889, p. 8, matching PDHD-D000064. The page pointer is promoted to PDHD-F000006, but the original page still requires direct inspection before any boundary can be fixed.

content_title: Prospecto: difusión de métodos y guía práctica al magisterio
note: Peer-reviewed historical scholarship attributes the inaugural pedagogical mission statement of México Intelectual to 1889, p. 2. The passage describes diffusion of methods and systems and a practical guide for colleagues in the teaching profession. Promoted to PDHD-F000010; the exact inaugural day remains a separate chronology conflict and the primary page still requires inspection.

content_title: Personal docente: renuncia de Dolores Correa y sustitución por Emilia Tuchs

content_title: Editorial framing of liberty and progress in the inaugural issue

content_title: Los ejercicios físicos en la escuela
author: Gregorio Torres Quintero

The lead is registered and cross-walked to PDHD-F000027 for source-critical analysis of embodied schooling and physical education; the historical HNDM page remains to be inspected before freezing.

A Biblioteca Nacional de México scholarly monograph cites the self-referential item El Periquito in the exact selected issue: Campeche, Tipografía El Fénix, núm. 4, 6 November 1870, p. 2. The citation appears within a study of animal symbolism and newspaper naming and is therefore promoted to PDHD-F000003 as a source-critical page target. The primary HNDM page remains uninspected and the coder boundary is not frozen.
